items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Because when I was in the band, in Lionel’s band, it was an integrated group.

ctx.x: Was there a racial issue in any of this?

I don’t know, quite honestly. I suppose that there is or was. I mean because we’re talking about America and race is always an issue one way or another. I have never felt it particularly in my own experience in dealing with record companies or industry people or even other musicians. I’ve never thought in terms of race, in terms of who do I want to play with. The only black and white I care about is the music on the page, personally. But I have had discussions with people, a lot of different people, and I had…
Sometimes I think people create one so they have something to write about.
